title: Deny order operations without permission
objective: Confirm that create and edit operations are denied when the customer lacks ORDER_EDIT and do not change order data.
preconditions: A synthetic customer is signed in without ORDER_EDIT permission.
For the edit subtest, a synthetic order exists with a recorded quantity of 5.

test_data.name: permission variants
test_data.description: Create and edit attempts performed by the same customer without ORDER_EDIT.

steps.action: Attempt the order operation specified by the current subtest.
steps.expected_result: The operation is denied and no order data is changed.

subtests.title: Create without permission
subtests.expected_result: The operation is denied and no order data is changed.

subtests.title: Edit without permission
subtests.expected_result: The operation is denied and no order data is changed.

postconditions: No order is created or changed by either denied attempt.
cleanup: Remove the synthetic order used by the edit subtest.
notes: Create and edit are subtests because the actor, permission rule, denial behavior, and no-change oracle are shared.
